notes:
### Added
- **Premium UI refresh.** A coordinated design layer over the base sheet: new
  geometry/shadow/hairline/motion tokens, a glass header with a brand tile, a
  stronger active-tab treatment, gradient primary buttons with press feedback,
  segmented tabs, pill toggles, focus-visible rings, card-style series/set/
  search/scan rows, owned-card ring plus check chip on card tiles, sheet
  treatment for modals, skeleton loaders in place of bare "Loading…" text, and a
  lit viewfinder stage on the idle Scan tab. Every value derives from the
  existing theme variables, so all twelve themes (and System) inherit it.
- **Vault-door brand.** The launcher icon, PWA icons, favicon, apple-touch icon,
  cold-start splashes and the in-app header/splash/tour mark are now a vault
  door (brushed gold rings over a deep slate plate) drawn procedurally by
  `scripts/generate-icons.mjs`, replacing the flat Poké Ball. Includes an
  Android 13+ **monochrome layer** for themed (Material You) icons and a
  `splash_icon` wired into the Android 12+ SplashScreen API
  (`windowSplashScreenBackground`/`AnimatedIcon`, `postSplashScreenTheme`).
- **Inter Variable typography.** The UI now renders in a self-hosted Inter
  variable face (bundled woff2, offline-safe, system stack as fallback) with
  tabular numerals in stats.
- **Motion.** Route changes fade/rise in, modals enter and exit as sheets
  (kept mounted through the exit), card art fades in on decode, the bottom-nav
  indicator slides between tabs, the app cross-fades in after the splash, card
  grids stagger subtly, and a set reaching 100% plays a one-off sparkle burst.
  Everything honours `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- **Haptic feedback** (`@capacitor/haptics`, default on, Settings toggle):
  light taps for navigation/steppers/shutter, a success pattern when a scan
  lands or cards are added, a warning pattern when a capture needs review, and
  a success pattern on set completion. Native-only; no-ops on the web.
- Set-completion celebration (sparkle burst over the progress bar), rich empty
  states (search, no-matches, set not found, scanning off, no card data) and
  theme-picker mini previews (background/accent/soft swatches instead of dots).

### Changed
- The bottom nav no longer drifts sideways between pages: the scrollbar gutter
  is suppressed so the fixed bar and the centred content column always agree.
- Accent-derived glows: the button glow, page-top wash and scan viewfinder
  stage now follow the active theme's accent (Sky/Sakura/Nebula/Abyss… glow in
  their own colour instead of default amber).

### Fixed
- Broken card images now fall back to the named placeholder instead of leaving
  an invisible hole (image fade-in component handles the cached and error
  cases).
- The Scan tab no longer shows the never-resolving "Preparing index: N of M"
  line (the shortfall is a handful of unreachable catalogue images; the index
  still tops itself up in the background).

### Notes
- No scan-index rebuild required: the descriptor, `SCAN_VERSION` and the card
  data are untouched; `DATA_VERSION` is unchanged.
- `@capacitor/haptics` is a new native dependency — the local APK build runs
  `npx cap sync android` as usual.
